scope: World-aware physical copy face observations after projected cost departures. No card admissions. Full-set acceptance remains open.
cause: The real-game face helper falls back to raw immutable metadata when a projected object has a new generation. The speculative world already retains the correct private Single/Double recipe, but that fallback discarded it.
correction: CharacteristicQuery builds FaceView directly from the current CharacteristicWorld recipe. A pure FaceView::from_faces builder reads the frozen physical structure, and the existing exact-ref transform serial is used only on the battlefield. No added state, hot Object fields or public wire fields.

rules.meaning: A token copy retains the actual source permanent physical face structure independently of the current copied definition.

regressions.before_fix: Two meaningful paid-producer tests failed complete projected-versus-actual ObjectView equality. The only difference was face: Single Taskmaster/Monica token incorrectly gained a back face in projection; Double Arc/Arc token lost its faces. Explicit private recipe equality already passed.
regressions.matrix: Both seats, each Single/Double paid-produced token, requested graveyard/exile and Rest in Peace replacement to exile.
regressions.paid_setup: Taskmaster plus Monica and Molten; or actual Monica/Molten DFC token, paid Shuri Arc overlay, then second paid Molten. Real printed costs, target groups and public legend choices use the existing checked helper. Rest in Peace is paid.
regressions.bounded_departure: Actual move_object_raw is compared to FundingState::cost_departures before token SBA cessation; these final departure primitives are bounded core continuations, not a claim that an extra sacrifice-card activation was played.
regressions.ownership_privacy: Funding source resources and retained private recipes are asserted. Complete both-player observations and parent snapshot stay unchanged. Actual branch survives parent disposal and restores its snapshot; paid setup actions use existing raw/index/wrong-actor/restore checks.

sources.coverage: Prior full14 Java bodies,12 frozen Oracle records,26 card/provenance bodies retained. All26 Rust/provenance source pins rehashed exact at this correction. Existing direct-copy source facts and primary rule remain unchanged.
